key.name: server-settings
key.summary: A list of server setting maps
key.description: A list of {name, url, frequency, timeout, isGet, notifies, visible, ignoreTLSErrors, ignoreRedirects} keys mapped to string values, one list entry per server panel.

key.name: server-settings-2
key.summary: A list of server setting maps - version 2
key.description: An 'aa{sv}' list of {name, url, frequency, timeout, verb, notifies, visible, ignoreTLSErrors, ignoreRedirects, headers} keys mapped to GVariant values. One list entry per server panel. The 'headers' value is itself 'aa{sv}', a list of header maps each with 'name' and 'value' keys. This version adds the 'headers' key, replaces the 'isGet' boolean with a 'verb' string, and changed coerced strings to their variant type (string to boolean, etc). .
